summary: HCA Healthcare filed an 8-K reporting Q2 2026 earnings and a quarterly dividend declaration, neither of which constitutes a special situation. The filing provides standard financial disclosures, updated guidance, and a dividend of $0.78/share payable September 30, 2026. There are no acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, tender offers, going-private transactions, capital returns beyond routine dividends, spin-offs, rights offerings, restructuring, liquidations, delistings, issuer tenders, deal terminations, SPACs, or forced management changes. The filing is a routine current report with no special situation event. What to watch: None.
